def collapse_ints(nums: list[int]) -> str:
    """See SPEC.md."""
    distinct = sorted(set(nums))
    if not distinct:
        return ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(distinct)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and distinct[j + 1] == distinct[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        run = distinct[i:j + 1]
        if len(run) >= 4:
            first, last = run[0], run[-1]
            parts.append(_fmt(first, in_range=True) + "-" + _fmt(last, in_range=True))
        else:
            for x in run:
                parts.append(_fmt(x, in_range=False))
        i = j + 1
    return ",".join(parts)


def _fmt(x: int, in_range: bool) -> str:
    if in_range and x < 0:
        return f"({x})"
    return str(x)
```
